# hg dash

**What this page tells you:** every `hg dash` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Declared dashboards and alerts vs what grafana actually imported.

## Synopsis

```text
hg dash list [flags]
hg dash errors [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Compares declared dashboard ConfigMaps with what Grafana actually imported (by uid, params typed). Unrelated to `hg nexus`, which compiles the Nexus canvas.

## `hg dash list`

```text
hg dash list [flags]
```

Declared vs imported dashboards and alerts.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--app` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one app's dashboards. |

## `hg dash errors`

```text
hg dash errors [flags]
```

Broken datasources and expressions.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
